scenes.title: Sky Scene 4 — Weather Story in the Sky
scenes.brief: Weather-themed sky scene combining sun, rain, rainbow and moving flying objects.
targetExamples: The balloon is rising.
The airplane is flying.
The helicopter is near the rain cloud.
It is raining.
The kite is under the rainbow.

scenes.title: Sky Scene 5 — Big, Small and Counting
scenes.brief: Sky comparison scene with one big balloon, one small airplane, two clouds, three birds and one kite.
targetExamples: The balloon is big.
The airplane is small.
The long cloud is white.
There are three little yellow birds.
The kite is colourful.

scenes.title: Sky Scene 6 — Travelling Through the Sky
scenes.brief: Travel-and-direction sky scene with airplane, helicopter, balloon, birds and kite.
targetExamples: The airplane is flying across the sky.
The helicopter is flying on the right.
The balloon is floating in the middle.
The birds are flying together.
The kite is near the rainbow.

scenes.title: Sky Scene 8 — Flying in Different Directions

scenes.brief: Five flying subjects each showing one clear type of movement: hot-air balloon rising, airplane flying, eagle gliding, helicopter hovering and kite flying in the wind.
targetExamples: The balloon is rising.
The airplane is flying.
The eagle is gliding.
The helicopter is hovering.
The kite is flying in the wind.

scenes.brief: Visible size, colour and counting contrasts among flying objects and clouds.
targetExamples: The balloon is big.
The airplane is small.
The balloon is bigger than the airplane.
There are three little yellow birds.
The kite is colourful.

scenes.brief: Six spatial relationships in the sky: above, below, next to, between, under and near.
targetExamples: The balloon is above the mountain.
The airplane is below the cloud.
The eagle is next to the balloon.
The helicopter is between the clouds.
The kite is under the rainbow.
The birds are near the cloud.
